title: Generate text with AI
description: Completes a free-form prompt with an AI model and returns plain text.

prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.description: The task for the AI, for example a question or a request to write something.

instructions.title: Instructions
instructions.description: Optional style or format guidance, for example tone or language.

maxLength.title: Maximum length
maxLength.description: Upper bound on the answer length in characters, as a positive whole number (default 1000).
